fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) combine the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block (author/publisher references resolved against the graph) with the full article body parsed from HTML, since this site's JSON-LD never carries articleBody. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) come from the site-wide /feed/ and already include full body text via content:encoded.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

description.title: Description
description.description: Article summary/dek, from the page's <meta name="description"> tag, falling back to the JSON-LD WebPage node's description (article-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article content, parsed from the page HTML (div.entry-content > div.content-inner) since JSON-LD never carries articleBody on this site (article-mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Article-mode: byline name(s), comma-joined, resolved from the JSON-LD graph's Person node(s). Latest-mode: plain byline name string from the RSS feed's dc:creator.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name ("Organiser"), resolved from the JSON-LD graph's Organization node (article-mode).

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Article section/category tags, e.g. ['Politics', 'Bharat', 'RSS News'] (article-mode, from JSON-LD).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Article-mode: raw passthrough of the JSON-LD keywords field -- a JSON object with sparse, non-contiguous string-integer keys on this site (not a list), e.g. {"2": "RSS", "3": "..."}. Not present in latest-mode.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date, from JSON-LD. Not observed populated on any sampled article (article-mode).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, resolved from the JSON-LD graph's ImageObject node (article-mode).

wordCount.title: Word count
wordCount.description: Article word count as computed by the site's SEO plugin (article-mode, from JSON-LD).

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: Article language code, e.g. 'en' (article-mode, from JSON-LD).

category.title: Category
category.description: List of category/tag names from the RSS item's <category> tags, e.g. ['Bharat', 'Analysis', 'MGNREGA'] (latest-mode).

contentEncoded.title: Content (encoded)
contentEncoded.description:
Full article body as HTML markup (/

tags), from the RSS feed's content:encoded element -- ~1.4x longer than on sampled items (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
